_about: Per-report handling rules for stage 2. Curation, not derived data — kept here rather than in nugrade_data.db because stage 1 rebuilds that database wholesale and would erase them. Every entry needs a 'reason'; loading fails otherwise, since an override nobody can explain cannot be reviewed or retired.

_keys.reason: required — why this document needs special handling
_keys.action: what a human should do about it, e.g. 'ocr'
_keys.strip_references: force reference truncation on or off
_keys.language: non-English marker; SciBERT should not embed these
_keys.duplicate_of: another EXFOR entry sharing this document
